settings.subheading: You found your way back here.
settings.gentleNote: Some things don't need to happen every day to still matter.
rotatingMessages: I was wondering when you'd find this.
There are probably things here you haven't discovered yet.
Some things are better kept here.

cards: Things that are easier to write here.
If Our Situation Was a Song...
One song that says what words can't.
Maybe we can just talk normally again.
story: The part where ordinary conversations quietly became something I kept looking forward to.
No dramatic music. Just the start.
Tiny messages, random topics, and that comfortable feeling of not needing to perform.
This is where the little world began.
Whenever we forgot to be serious
The jokes, the teasing, and the parts that probably make no sense to anyone else.
Some memories are basically nonsense with meaning.
This happened. We went through it. We're still here. No pressure, no blame, just a page that remembers gently.
Whenever you're comfortable, this place is here.
A date with its own quiet underline. Replace this with the real memory when ready.
Maybe nothing huge. Maybe just talking normally again. Either way, the door stays soft.
notes: Something I wanted to tell you
I made this so there would be a place where things could wait patiently.
Sometimes silence is not distance. Sometimes it is just life being complicated.
Something I was scared to say
This one unlocks after you find five stars in the Secret Room.
You never have to rush back here. It still counts, even quietly.
openWhen: Here is a tiny normal thing: I hope you drank water today. Very emotional, I know.
Open when you're having a bad day
No fixing speech. Just this: breathe, unclench your jaw, and take the day in smaller pieces.
Open when you need to laugh
Imagine me trying to act mysterious while building an entire secret website. Exactly.
Goodnight, Chelsiiii. Nothing demanding. Just a soft place to end the day.
photos: Replace this caption with the real story.
A small piece of the scrapbook.
The kind of thing that belongs here.
Some pages do not need too many words.

song.title: The song for now
song.intro:
If I had to explain us without saying anything...

I'd probably play you this.
song.why: I don't know if this song explains everything... but somehow it says the things I don't know how to.

archivedSongs: This one belonged to a different version of us.
observations: You have a way of making small replies feel like they have a whole expression behind them.
Randomly specific stupidity. Especially when nobody else would understand why it is funny.
The pauses, the typing rhythm, the way you say things without making them too obvious.
Things you probably don't realize I notice
When you are careful with words because life around you is not always simple.
scenarios: If we had one completely free day
No huge plan. Food, a walk, music in the background, and zero pretending to be busy.
If we could randomly travel somewhere
Some place with lights at night and enough quiet that conversation can wander.
If we met for the first time today
I think I would still notice you. Annoyingly quickly, probably.
If we could disappear for a day
Phones quiet. No explanations. Just a day that belongs to nobody else.
